no-restricted-syntax.message: kavya: no inline styles — Tailwind only

settings.__note: eslintrc fallback for ESLint <9 only. `__origin` used to be a TOP-LEVEL key; the eslintrc schema validator rejects unknown top-level properties on both 8.57 and 9.39, so frontend.sh's fallback branch could only ever land in 'unavailable'. Unknown keys are legal inside `settings`. This file duplicates eslint.sage.mjs's rules with no shared source: eslint.sage.mjs compares the two at load time and prints a NOT CHECKED line on stderr when they diverge.
settings.__missing_jsx_parserOptions_was: the same JSX hole as the flat config: without ecmaFeatures.jsx every .jsx file linted through this config was reported as 'Parsing error: Unexpected token <'
